title: Goal Parser Interpretation
description: Interpret a string command by replacing '()' with 'o', '(al)' with 'al', and keeping 'G' as is.
pseudocode:
1. result = ''
2. for i from 0 to command.length - 1:
3.   if command[i] == 'G': result += 'G'
4.   else if command[i] == '(' and command[i+1] == ')': result += 'o'; i++
5.   else: result += 'al'; i += 3
